name: Animated Collection
description: A collection block whose items spring between a stacked list, a two-column card grid and a tilted pack, driven by a pill tab switcher.
interactionNotes: Clicking a pill tab morphs the whole collection: items glide to their new positions with a spring, the image boxes resize, and the info blocks blur out when the pack forms and blur back in elsewhere. In pack view a caption with the joined titles and the piece count fades in under the stack. The active tab pill slides between the tabs, every tab is a real button with a visible focus ring, and with `prefers-reduced-motion` the springs, blurs and fades become instant.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading above the tab switcher.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection items; each has `id`, `title`, `subtitle`, `idNumber` and `image` (any `` source, such as a URL or an inline SVG data URI). Without them, two sample items appear.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view the collection starts in.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Site preview only — the collection walks list, card and pack by itself. Leave it off in normal use; a real interaction never fires while it runs.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the outer block.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Accent of the active view tab; leave it empty to keep the theme's primary color.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the card and pack images in pixels; the list thumbnails keep their own small radius.

props.name: showMeta
props.description: Show the subtitle and year under each title, or keep only the title.

tips: `image` accepts any `` source — a remote URL, a local path or an inline SVG data URI; the built-in samples are inline gradients, so the component makes no external requests.
With a single item the pack view keeps it centered; from two items on, the cards fan out to their mirrored poses.
From the third item on, extra cards stack centered in pack view with no pose, so a deep pile stays tidy.
`defaultView` is only the starting point; the component keeps its own view state afterwards.
The block is `max-w-xl` and fills the width it is given up to that; widen it with `className` when the surrounding layout is narrow.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` the springs, blurs and fades land instantly.
